name: s-pdf
description: S-PDF – a self-hosted, open-source PDF platform (merge, split, convert, edit and more).
author: kibouakari

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.converter:install: python -m venv services/converter/.venv && services\converter\.venv\Scripts\pip install -r services/converter/requirements.txt
